engagement.client: Solstice Financial Services (SYNTHETIC - fictitious entity created for AssureAI pilot testing; not a real client)

risk.risk_description: Untested or unapproved standard changes could be deployed to production without appropriate governance.

control.control_objective: To ensure that standard changes are tested and approved by the Change Advisory Board (CAB) prior to deployment to production.
control.suggested_control_description: Standard changes tested and CAB approved before deployment.
control.control_frequency: Per event (triggered by a standard change request)
control.expected_evidence: CAB approval record and test evidence in the change management tool.
control.suggested_test_procedures_tod: Inspect the RACM and walkthrough documentation to confirm the control is designed to require testing and CAB approval of standard changes prior to deployment.
control.suggested_test_procedures_toe: For a sample of standard changes in the period, inspect testing evidence and the CAB approval record to confirm each change was tested and approved before deployment.
